entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hi, you've reached VeloFit customer support. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hello, Diana. I... I'm calling because I need to return my VeloBand Cadence Sensor. I'm just so disappointed.
I'm sorry to hear that. I can definitely look into the return options for you. Could I please get your name and order number?
Yes, it's Alex Chen, order number 774-VF-9821.

Thank you, Alex. I see your order here, delivered on December 17th, so about 22 days ago. To make sure I understand correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's not broken, I just... I find it really hard to use. The menu system is so confusing. I've read the user manual twice, and I still can't figure out the settings I need.

Honestly, I just expected more from it. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for a long time, and this is the first time I've felt let down. I feel terrible calling, but I really needed this money back for other things.

I understand completely. It's frustrating when a new piece of gear doesn't feel intuitive from the start. Let me just pull up our current return policy and see what we can do. Please hold for one moment.
Okay, thank you for your patience, Alex. I've just checked, and you are well within the 90-day return window for a full refund.
Oh, really? I was so worried I had missed the deadline. That's... that's such a relief. Are you sure?

Absolutely. I can go ahead and authorize that return for you right now. I'm sending a prepaid shipping label to the email we have on file. Just print it out, attach it to the box, and drop it off. Once we receive it, the refund will be processed.
Wow. Thank you so much, Diana! You've really helped me out. I was so stressed about this. This is why I stick with VeloFit.
Of course, Alex! We appreciate your business and I'm glad I could resolve this for you. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
